name: Romancing the Sun
source:
Date and find love or the sun goes out. Feel life where the world seems close and intense, a bad date can feel like the end of the world and might be.

Step in your shoes as they make friends, meet people, go to parties, and date!

Dawn is a highschool graduate that most people forgot. Her motivation runs off of fumes from the energy that she used to have. She manages to keep up appearances in front of her parents and aggressively goal-oriented friend Conney.

Build a relationship with Dawn, the people around her, and the community to pull through the blinking sun crisis.
